Correspondence of the von Rosenberg lords with their advocates in various legal matters.

Date: 1541–1604, 1625–1633

Contains: 1. Fol. 1–124 Dr Georg Ruprecht of Marktbreit, 1584–1598; 2. Fol. 126–211 Lic. Konrad Ziegler of Kitzingen, 1556–1568; 3. Fol. 212–279 Dr Lucas Goll of Speyer, 1625–1631; 4. Fol. 280–317 Dr Simon Eisen of Rothenburg, 1585–1586; 5. Fol. 318–337 Lic. Amandus Wolf of Speyer, 1541–1558; 6. Fol. 338–359 Dr Georg Spitzer, 1593–1597; 7. Fol. 360–448 Dr Marcus Eisenmenger of Würzburg, 1574–1586; 8. Fol. 449–523 Dr Johann Portius of Speyer, 1558–1564; 9. Fol. 524–562 Dr Marx Schwickert, 1584–1586; 10. Fol. 563–583 Dr Christoph Erbermann of Öhringen, 1604, 1625–1633; 11. Fol. 584–608 Lic. Stefan Feierabent of Heilbronn, 1566–1567.

Extent: 1 volume, fols. 1–608
